model.name: R20.27: Gate detail links to its source/evidence.
model.description: A GATE scenario unit's detail view MUST show a clickable link to its source/evidence — the verification artifact (test log, screenshot, deploy manifest, DET-3x output) that backs the gate's verdict. CLICKABLE in detail drawer: clicking the evidence link NAVIGATES to the verification artifact (log, screenshot, deploy manifest). Navigable, not just text.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "each type has a link to a source file:line, classes to the puml file and the resulting svg preview, same as methods to the puml AND the ts code, same as tests and gates"

intendedChain.useCase: gateDetail.evidenceLink — Gate shows link to verification evidence
intendedChain.test: RED: open R20.27 detail → assert source link(s) present + clickable. Links must be CLICKABLE (navigate on click, not just text). Currently FAILS.

architectDesign.pattern: Gate units have model.evidence (screenshot path or det-3x log). Render a clickable link: ✅ Gate evidence → preview or /edit. If evidence is a .png → render inline image preview. If evidence is a log file → text preview.
architectDesign.gate: Open a Gate detail → evidence link renders. Screenshot gates show inline image. Log gates show text preview.
